name: {{ADAPTER_NAME}}
description: Pluggable, project-agnostic Cline adapter. This file is the SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for per-project facts. To use it in any new project: copy this .cline/ folder into the project root, then edit only the 'projectConfig' block below (name, stack, layer paths, commands, gates, constraints). The .cline/rules, .cline/workflows, and .cline/memory-bank markdown are generic templates that resolve their specifics from this file — do not hand-edit them per project except to add genuinely project-specific patterns.

_setup.how: 1) Copy this .cline/ folder into any project root. 2) Edit projectConfig.projectName, targetEnvironment, layerPaths, constraints, commands, and verificationGates below. 3) Run the 'update memory bank' trigger on first session to re-seed the generic memory-bank templates with this project's real facts. See .cline/README.md for a walkthrough.

projectConfig.description: One-line description of what this project is and does.

pureDomainDecoupling.rule: This layer must remain 100% pure (no UI/framework/DOM imports). If a change seems to need a UI import, that logic belongs in the presentation layer.
pureDomainDecoupling._note: Set enabled:false if your project has no such boundary.

hiddenInformation.rule: If your project has hidden/internal/private state that must never leak to the outside, document the invariant here (what is hidden, under what viewer/context it may be revealed) and forbid any debug path that exposes it during active use.
hiddenInformation._note: Optional. Example from a hidden-information game: 'opponent piece ranks must never be revealed during active play'.

aiFairness.rule: If an AI/automated agent exists, it must derive decisions only from public/belief-derived inputs, never direct reads of hidden state.
aiFairness._note: Optional. Only relevant if the project contains an AI/opponent.

styling.rule: Use semantic theme tokens from {{STYLES_PATH}}; no hardcoded hex or arbitrary-value classes.
styling.prohibited: arbitrary value classes like bg-[#1a1a1a] or text-[#ffffff]
styling._note: Fill allowedTokens with this project's semantic token names.

gitHistory.rule: Never force-push or rebase published commits. If the repo syncs with an external service (e.g. Lovable), ask before rewriting history.

additionalConstraints: Add any project-specific hard invariants here (business rules, data invariants, architecture boundaries). Markdown rules reference this list.

memoryBank.note: Standard Cline Memory Bank pattern (docs.cline.bot/best-practices/memory-bank). activeContext.md and progress.md are the volatile files — update every real session. projectbrief/productContext/systemPatterns/techContext change rarely.

rulesIndex.note: Enable exactly one mode file at a time in the Cline rules toggle UI, alongside the always-on baseline. weeklyReview is intended for once-per-week use only.
